description: An audit pipeline redacts sensitive fields by schema while retaining investigation context and sink-specific event views.

controls.redaction_stage: producer middleware before serialization and fan-out
controls.redaction_strategy: schema-based redaction with salted fingerprints for correlation

sink_views.siem: redacted security view with actor, tenant, object, action, decision, approval, policy version, and correlation ID
sink_views.support: ticket-scoped view without tokens, cookies, personal data, or raw payloads
sink_views.data_lake: encrypted restricted raw store with audited break-glass access

controls.unmask_workflow: requires scoped reason, approver, expiry, and records a separate redacted unmask audit event
tests: auth header redacted before APM ingestion
unmask event audited without raw value
